entries.claim: Task 5's fallback says to create a temporary seed case made only of a prompt (`/seldon` plus the dump), but the eval docs say a case directory with no grader fails to load with an `invalid case.yaml` error, so the fallback breaks as written.
entries.failure_scenario: The `.jsonl` format is undocumented (a flagged assumption), so suppose the hand-written history.jsonl is rejected. The executor then follows line 142 and creates evals/<seed>/prompt.md with no graders/ entry. `claude plugin eval . --case <seed> --trust-plugin --no-publish --ablation none --keep-temp` refuses to load the case (plugin-evals.md: 'a case without at least one grader fails to load ... names `graders`'). No session runs and no transcript is captured, so Task 5 Verify (1) can't reach AC3 until the executor improvises a grader the plan never names.
